points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: All eight manifest-linked original workspace packages pass structural examiner checks, though several converged/periodic statuses conflict with force histories or last inner ratio. Raw files are not tracked in the attempt commit.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Read-only examiner passes eight original workspace packages and extracted be266cd historical report; workspace report alone fails missing run_manifest. Structural checks do not establish numerical correctness.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Re20 metadata says converged despite final400 Cd −16.5748..−1.01497 and Cl −9.56809..7.79131; Re200 final ratio0.7 versus target0.001. Seven steady histories remain unsettled or incomplete.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Workspace Re20 forces are strongly unsettled; M080 laminar final400 Cl reaches −128.693; Re200 t180–300 Cd −1.24931..−1.07427 and Cl 1.13943..1.22122 do not establish a credible periodic wake.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: All seven attempt steady force figures collapse to a vertical line because physical_time=0. Re200 full-history drag is compressed and no numeric St is reported; selected field/residual figures exist.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Six-page compiled report includes methods and figures and discloses first-order production, but convergence/periodic labels disagree with recovered histories and strict final ratio.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: be266cd run_manifest and selected validator calls/final response affirm eight workspace paths and coefficients. Exact runtime binary and image-to-CSV correspondence are unbound; raw packages are workspace-only.
